scope: All assets included in the temperate forest vertical slice

variation.coordinate_frame: original source voxel coordinates; stable across instance rotation, edits and restore

palette_policy: Preserve species and material base palettes; do not recolor petals, stems, stone or other materials to tree green or bark brown. Apply deterministic subtle voxel and face variation to each material.
geometry_policy: Appearance-only update: preserve occupancy, voxel pitch, seeds, source geometry identity and user endorsement/rejection decisions.
foliage_policy: Existing approved foliage cutouts remain foliage-only; the common color variation policy does not make wood, petals or nonfoliage materials transparent.
activation_status: Forge rollout complete: 5956 saved assets; runtime engine integration remains separately validated
